limits: No normal combat playthrough, current completion rounds, human time, A/B combat balance, browser/Pages or art approval.
A/B geometry uses existing isolated traversal with removed other actors and direct movement replenishment; not normal move-budget evidence.
Optional dry-shoulder uses ordinary move/jump/wait/tick after staged start/removal of other actors, with no post-start position/HP/movement writes.
Interaction/save/outcome/16-entry positive cases supply arrivals and subdued enemies before mounting, so they are boundary fixtures, not clear-time evidence.
Drain defect is additionally reproduced on the original full living/unsubdued roster with only sluice-complete/pending facts supplied. No game fix or data edits.
reachabilityLimit: Sluice does not require defeating these two distant actors; state is not excluded by game contracts. No normal-combat approach/E run reproduced the simultaneous state. Real E was tested with staged safe arrivals/subdued enemies; original living-roster cross-check supplies sluice/pending facts.
